candidates.current_role: Waller County Commissioner, Precinct 4
candidates.background: Justin Beckendorff is the Waller County Precinct 4 Commissioner and won the Republican nomination for county judge in March 2026. He will succeed County Judge Trey Duhon, who did not seek reelection after three terms. His father, Glenn Beckendorff, previously served as Waller County judge.

priorities.text: Says he will fight for smart growth, strong communities, more law enforcement, lower taxes, and a solid investment in mobility infrastructure.
Says he wants to use county bond programs to address growth and build infrastructure in a way that makes financial and logistical sense.

record.text: Serves as Waller County Precinct 4 Commissioner and has presided over commissioners court in the county judge's absence, by his account.

notes.text: Won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary with 3,762 votes (about 67%) to 1,878 for Brent Davis, according to unofficial results; no Democrat filed.

q_county_tax.summary: Calls for lower taxes and also for solid investment in roads, and describes the challenge as paying for road and service needs while staying responsible on tax rates.
